title: IVG Intense Salts Strawberry Watermelon 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Strawberry Watermelon combines two classic fruits. The sweet burst of ripe Strawberries pairs with the light, refreshing taste of Watermelon, delivering a vape that’s fruity and easy to enjoy all day. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid provides well-rounded flavour, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, it’s designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) devices including pod kits, vape pens, and starter systems. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Strawberry Watermelon captures both richness and freshness in a simple, satisfying format.
